front: Ring all-reduce bytes sent per rank?
back: 2 × (N − 1)/N × S. It approaches 2S, so bandwidth cost is flat in N; latency grows with 2(N − 1) steps.

front: ZeRO communication cost vs plain DP?
back: Stages 1 and 2: same volume as DP. Stage 3: about 1.5× DP, because weights are gathered for forward and backward.
